items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And he asked Cal and I to join his band.

ctx.x: So we began to make gigs. So I ran into a saxophone player who played like Guy Lombardo. His whole band played like Guy Lombardo. Now, will you imagine that. And he asked Cal and I to join his band. Now we played
exactly like Guy Lombardo. You couldn't tell -- This was a black band?
